attr.title: Dead Space
attr.desc: The 2011 Dead Space mobile survival-horror game by IronMonkey Studios, running its original Android ARM library directly on Linux through a bionic/JNI compatibility loader.
attr.inst: Supply your own Dead Space Mobile for Xperia Play v1.1.33 APK, ZIP, or extracted folder. Put it in ports/deadspace/; the donor filename does not matter and the first launch extracts and validates it automatically. Keep the port release named deadspace-native-arm.zip. Wait for PortMaster's Finished running autoinstall dialog, then reboot normally before looking for the game in Ports. The supported native-library SHA1 is 0ed42b611415015807f759ec9b5457857143ce39. No game data is included.
